items.title: CART Q3 Earnings Miss, Revenues Beat, DoorDash Deal Takes Focus
items.summary: Instacart (CART) reported Q3 2026 earnings of 60 cents per share, missing estimates of 64 cents, though revenues beat expectations at $1.095B with 16.6% growth. Orders rose 10% to 91.4 million and advertising revenues surged 23% to $331 million. DoorDash announced a definitive agreement to acquire Instacart for approximately $17 billion ($65 per share), representing a 26% premium. The acquisition is expected to close in late 2027 or early 2028.
